senses.gloss: Muci, n. of an ancient king: Mvy 〔3562〕. Seems to correspond to Pali Mucala, DPPN.

Mucila, n. of an asura: Mahāsamāj., Waldschmidt, Kl. Skt. Texte 4, 〔179, last line〕; cf. Mucilinda 5 (who is associated with Vemacitrin, as Mucila is with Vemacitra; see Waldschmidtʼs note, which makes the definite identification).
Mucilindā, n. of a nāga maid: Kv 〔3.23〕.
